Class AmwpToon

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.wire.AmwpToon
public final class AmwpToon extends Object
The AmwpToon class reads and writes the line text used inside an AMWP execute frame. TOON is that line text. The text is not JSON. The class does not use the Roux message codec. // @aa-sdd G-13 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Method Details

    • encodeExecute

      public static byte[] encodeExecute(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody body)
      The method writes an execute request as UTF-8 lines. cell_id and execution_target are always written. A true ephemeral, tool-calling, burner-cloud, or think-stream flag writes its line. A false sendReasoningEffort writes send_reasoning_effort: false. A non-empty reasoning effort, think value, or pool boot writes its line. A present temperature writes temperature. A present completion cap writes max_completion_tokens. The working set is written after working_set:. Each turn writes role and text. A designated turn also writes head: true.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the execute request.
      Returns:
      The return value is the UTF-8 text.

    • decodeExecute

      public static AmwpToon.ExecuteBody decodeExecute(byte[] raw)
      The method reads an execute request from UTF-8 lines. A null or empty array returns a new AmwpToon.ExecuteBody with the field defaults. Each known key fills the matching field. A temperature or completion cap that is not a number leaves that present flag false. A line that starts with - role: begins a new AmwpToon.Turn. A later text: or head: line fills the current turn. A text or head line before any role is ignored. An unknown line is ignored.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw bytes are the UTF-8 text, and they may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed request.

    • encodeError

      public static byte[] encodeError(String reason, String message)
      The method writes an error body as two UTF-8 lines. The first line is reason:. The second line is message:.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the token stored after reason:.
      message - The message is the banner text stored after message:.
      Returns:
      The return value is the UTF-8 text.

    • decodeError

      public static AmwpToon.ErrorBody decodeError(String raw)
      The method reads an error body. A null body returns an empty message and leaves structured false. A body that does not start with reason: stores the whole text as the message. A body that starts with reason: sets structured and reads reason and message lines. Other lines in a structured body are ignored.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text is the error payload, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed error, or a plain banner.

    • encodeFacts

      public static byte[] encodeFacts(String airGap, int numCtx)
      The method writes Init facts with the token counts left at 0. It calls encodeFacts(String, int, int, int).
      Parameters:
      airGap - The word is true, false, or unset.
      numCtx - The integer is the server context size, and a new server always writes it.
      Returns:
      The return value is the UTF-8 text.

    • encodeFacts

      public static byte[] encodeFacts(String airGap, int numCtx, int managedTokens, int headCount)
      The method writes four Init fact lines. A null or empty air-gap word is written as unset. The lines are air-gap, num-ctx, managed-tokens, and head-count. A managed-token count of 0 means unset. A head count of 0 means unset.
      Parameters:
      airGap - The word is true, false, or unset.
      numCtx - The integer is the server context size.
      managedTokens - The count is the sink allowance, and 0 means unset.
      headCount - The count is how many turns may lock, and 0 means unset.
      Returns:
      The return value is the UTF-8 text.

    • decodeFacts

      public static AmwpToon.SessionFacts decodeFacts(byte[] raw)
      The method reads Init facts. A null or empty body returns facts with reported false. Any other body sets reported. air-gap stores the word. num-ctx stores the integer and sets numCtxPresent. A num-ctx value that is not an integer clears numCtxPresent. managed-tokens stores the integer, and a bad integer stores 0. head-count stores the integer, and a bad integer stores 0. An unknown line is ignored.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw bytes are the Init body, and they may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed facts.

    • truth

      private static boolean truth(String raw)
      The method reads a boolean token from a line. true and yes match in any letter case. The token 1 matches only that exact character. Any other token returns false.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the text after the colon.
      Returns:
      The return value is true for true, yes, or 1.

    • esc

      private static String esc(String raw)
      The method escapes one field for a line. A null value returns an empty string. A backslash becomes two backslashes. A newline becomes \\n. A carriage return is removed.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the field text, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the escaped text.

    • unesc

      private static String unesc(String raw)
      The method reverses esc(String). A null value returns an empty string. \\n becomes a newline. A doubled backslash becomes one backslash. Any other backslash is kept, including the following character.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the escaped field, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the decoded text.
